description: "A Narrative of a Nine Months' Residence in New Zealand in 1827" by Augustus Earle is a historical account written in the early 20th century. The book offers a personal perspective of the early interactions between European settlers and the Māori people, describing the culture, customs, and conditions of New Zealand during that period.
